question: When a shuttle is hit high into the air, the player has time to hit a powerful overhand shot straight to the floor of the opponent's court. This is known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smash**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• A **smash** is a powerful overhand shot hit sharply downward into the opponent's court.
 
• It is considered one of the most offensive and aggressive shots in badminton.
 
• The smash is typically used to finish a rally and score a point.
 
• Executing a perfect smash requires precise timing, strength, and excellent positioning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Long Service:**

 
 
• In badminton, a long service is a type of serve where the shuttle is hit high and deep into the opponent's court, ideally landing near the back boundary line.
 
• It is commonly used in singles matches to push the opponent to the back of the court.
 
 
 
• **Rally:**
 
 
• A rally is a sequence of shots between opponents, starting with a serve and ending when the shuttlecock hits the ground.
 
• The objective is to keep the shuttle in play and outmaneuver the opponent to win the point.
 
 
 
• **Short Service:**
 
 
• In badminton, a short service is a serve where the shuttle is hit softly to land just over the net, typically near the front service line.
 
• It is commonly used in doubles matches to limit the opponent's attacking options.
 
 
 
• **Smash:**
 
 
• The smash is a crucial attacking shot in badminton, characterized by its speed and downward trajectory.
 
• It is often aimed at the opponent's court with the intent to end the rally and score a point.
 
• Proper technique involves a strong wrist snap and full-body coordination to maximize power.
 
• Players often jump to execute a jump smash, adding more power and angle to the shot.
